**▶ Online: https://radoslawo81.github.io/WebSpectrometer2.0/** (Chrome / Edge)

### New: AS7331 UV sensor / Nowość: czujnik UV AS7331
- *Tools → UV sensor (AS7331)…* – live **UVA / UVB / UVC in µW/cm²** over Web Serial, automatic gain, min / mean / max, trend, CSV log; the reading is stored with saved spectra and in the report. Covers the UVC (254 nm) and UVB that a camera spectrometer cannot see.
- *Narzędzia → Czujnik UV (AS7331)…* – natężenie **UVA / UVB / UVC w µW/cm²** na żywo, automatyczne wzmocnienie, statystyki, trend, zapis CSV; odczyt trafia do widm i raportu.
- **Firmware** for the LILYGO T-Display-S3 (ESP32-S3) with on-screen readout: [firmware/as7331-tdisplay-s3](https://github.com/radoslawo81/WebSpectrometer2.0/tree/main/firmware/as7331-tdisplay-s3) – automatic I2C pin and address detection.

⚠️ UVC is dangerous for eyes and skin – shield germicidal lamps. / UVC jest groźne dla oczu i skóry – osłaniaj lampy bakteriobójcze.

Full list: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/radoslawo81/WebSpectrometer2.0/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

### Offline package
Unzip `WebSpectrometer2.0-v2.1.0.zip` and serve the folder, e.g. `python3 -m http.server 8000`, then open http://localhost:8000.
